name: WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown (Roppongi)
card: 18th floor of Tokyo Midtown Tower, with art added to the mix
title: WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown (Roppongi) — a shared office with an artistic touch, on the 18th floor of the Tower
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown (Roppongi) is on the 18th floor of Tokyo Midtown Tower, directly connected to Roppongi Station on the Toei Oedo and Tokyo Metro Hibiya lines. The website presents it as a refined space that adds an element of art to a place for “design thinking”. It has an open space, meeting rooms, single-person rooms and rental offices. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Open space / meeting rooms (up to 12, and 13+) / single-person rooms / rental offices
Directly connected to exit 8 of Roppongi Sta. (Hibiya, Oedo lines)
concept: Design thinking and art
The website says of WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown (Roppongi): “We have created a refined space that adds an element of art to a place where you can always work with design thinking.”
It also has areas to refresh in — a base that builds a place to change your mood into the place you work.
steps: Shared space with an artistic touch
From the entrance, a space with an artistic touch begins.
The open space can be used without booking, and there are areas to refresh.
Rooms for up to 12, and larger rooms
There are meeting rooms for up to 12 and larger rooms for 13 or more.
Use them to welcome outside guests or for larger gatherings.
Rooms to shut yourself away and focus
Single-person rooms are for calls, online meetings and focused work.
There are rental offices too, and dedicated spaces (FLEX) can be entered 24 hours.

word.title: What is design thinking?
body: An approach that finds problems from the user's point of view and searches for answers by making and testing things.
WORK STYLING Tokyo Midtown (Roppongi) adds an element of art to a place for working this way.

name: WORK STYLING Futako-Tamagawa
card: Inside Tamagawa Takashimaya Shopping Center, on the ground floor of Keyaki Court
title: WORK STYLING Futako-Tamagawa — a shared office inside a shopping centre, on the ground floor of Keyaki Court at Tamagawa Takashimaya S.C.
lead: Mitsui Fudosan's WORK STYLING Futako-Tamagawa is on the ground floor of Keyaki Court at Tamagawa Takashimaya Shopping Center, a five-minute walk from Futako-Tamagawa Station on the Tokyu line. Its feature is being inside a shopping complex rather than a city-centre office building. It is open on weekends and holidays too, with an open space, meeting rooms and single-person rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Weekdays 8:00–21:00 / weekends and holidays 10:00–18:00 (closed New Year)
Open space / meeting rooms (2–12) / single-person rooms / phone booths
concept: Working inside a shopping centre

WORK STYLING Futako-Tamagawa is on the ground floor of Keyaki Court at Tamagawa Takashimaya Shopping Center. The website describes the centre as a large complex by the West Exit of Futako-Tamagawa Station that opened in 1969 as Japan's first suburban shopping centre.
Unlike the city-centre sites, it is a shared office close to where people live, open 10:00–18:00 on weekends and holidays too.
steps: Entered from the ground floor of a shopping complex
The entrance is on the ground floor of Keyaki Court.
The open space needs no booking, and drinks such as coffee and tea are provided.
Meeting rooms hold 2 to 12 people, by booking, in 10-minute units.
They are handy for meetings between people who live nearby.
Single-person rooms are booked in 10-minute units, and the official gallery shows many of them.
You can come in just for an online meeting in the middle of working from home.

word.title: What is a suburban shopping centre?
body: A large retail complex built near residential areas away from the city centre.
According to the website, Tamagawa Takashimaya Shopping Center opened in 1969 as Japan's first suburban shopping centre. WORK STYLING Futako-Tamagawa is inside it.

name: H¹T Roppongi
card: A 7th floor with booths, boxes and private rooms, one minute from exit 4a of Roppongi Station
title: H¹T Roppongi — a corporate shared office on the 7th floor of the Seishido Building, one minute from the station
lead: Nomura Real Estate's H¹T Roppongi is on the 7th floor of the Seishido Building, a one-minute walk from exit 4a of Roppongi Station (Tokyo Metro Hibiya and Toei Oedo lines). H¹T is a shared office for companies with no initial or base fees. This site stands out for its many kinds of solo seating — open space, booths, boxes and single-person rooms — and is open 7:30–22:00 on weekends and holidays too. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Open space 10 / 4 booths (1) / 4 boxes (1) / 10 rooms (1) / meeting rooms for 6 and 8
1 min from exit 4a of Roppongi Sta. (Hibiya, Oedo lines)
concept: Four ways to sit alone
H¹T Roppongi has 10 open-space seats, 4 single booths, 4 single boxes and 10 single rooms — four kinds of solo seating, from open seats to rooms with doors.

H¹T is Nomura Real Estate's satellite shared office for companies, usable for remote work, as a base between sales visits, and for seminars, training and interviews, the website says. The Roppongi site also opens on weekends and holidays.
steps: Use it in the gaps between appointments to check email or tidy up documents.
There are four single booths and four single boxes.
Seats for when you want to block other people's view a little.
Ten private rooms and two meeting rooms
There are ten single rooms, with doors, for online meetings.

word.title: What is an H¹T booth?
body: One of H¹T's seat types: a single seat separated by partitions.
H¹T Roppongi offers solo seats in steps — booths, boxes and rooms.

title: H¹T Ikebukuro East Exit THE GARDEN — a corporate shared office with 18 private rooms, on the 10th floor of the Ikebukuro Ito Building

H¹T is a shared office for companies with no initial or base fees. This site has 18 single-person rooms and 2 meeting rooms, and is open 7:00–22:30 on weekdays, weekends and holidays. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: H¹T Ikebukuro East Exit THE GARDEN
18 rooms (1 person) / meeting rooms for 4 and 6
3 min from the North Gate of JR Ikebukuro Sta. / 4 min from the Yurakucho Line / 5 min from the Seibu Ikebukuro Line
hero_cap: H¹T Ikebukuro East Exit THE GARDEN
concept: A corporate shared office built around private rooms

H¹T is Nomura Real Estate's satellite shared office for companies. With no initial or base fees, it can be used for remote work, as a base between sales visits, and for seminars, training and interviews, the website says.
Ikebukuro East Exit THE GARDEN consists of 18 single rooms and 2 meeting rooms. Its big feature is opening every day, weekends and holidays included, from 7:00 to 22:30.
steps: All seats are single rooms — 18 of them.
With doors, they let you take online meetings and calls without worrying about others.
Use them for small interviews and internal meetings.
Three minutes from the North Gate of JR Ikebukuro Station, four from the South Passage East Gate of the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line and five from the B1F gate of the Seibu Ikebukuro Line.
Open from 7:00, it suits the time before work or before heading out on visits.

word.title: What is a satellite office?
body: A small workplace set up away from the head office.
H¹T has many sites, mainly in the Tokyo area, as a “satellite shared office” that companies use for their staff.

name: H¹T Ochanomizu THE GARDEN
card: A 2nd floor with 11 private rooms, one minute from the Hijiribashi exit of JR Ochanomizu Station
title: H¹T Ochanomizu THE GARDEN — a private-room shared office on the 2nd floor of the Ochanomizu Hotaka Building, one minute from the station
lead: Nomura Real Estate's H¹T Ochanomizu THE GARDEN is on the 2nd floor of the Ochanomizu Hotaka Building, a one-minute walk from the Hijiribashi exit of JR Ochanomizu Station. H¹T is a shared office for companies with no initial or base fees. This small site consists only of 11 single-person rooms and is open 8:00–21:00 on weekdays. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 1 min from the Hijiribashi exit of JR Ochanomizu Sta.
concept: A small, rooms-only site one minute from the station
H¹T Ochanomizu THE GARDEN is made up only of 11 single rooms. With no open space or meeting rooms, it focuses entirely on places to concentrate alone.

It is on the 2nd floor of the Ochanomizu Hotaka Building, one minute from the Hijiribashi exit of JR Ochanomizu Station. H¹T is Nomura Real Estate's satellite shared office for companies, usable for remote work and as a base between sales visits.
steps: All seats are single rooms — 11 of them.
With doors, they work for online meetings too.
The website says it can be used for remote work, as a base between sales visits and for interviews.
Just a minute from the station, it is easy to drop in even for a short gap before your next appointment.
It is open 8:00–21:00 on weekdays and closed on weekends and holidays.
From before the start of the working day into the evening, it fits around weekday work.

word.title: What is an H¹T room?
body: One of H¹T's seat types: a private room for one person.
H¹T also has open space and semi-private “boxes”. Ochanomizu THE GARDEN consists of rooms only.

name: H¹T Shinjuku West Exit
card: A 9th floor in Nishi-Shinjuku with open seats, boxes, private rooms and 7 meeting rooms
title: H¹T Shinjuku West Exit — a corporate shared office with many seat types and meeting rooms, on the 9th floor of the Nishi-Shinjuku Showa Building
lead: Nomura Real Estate's H¹T Shinjuku West Exit is on the 9th floor of the Nishi-Shinjuku Showa Building, a two-minute walk from the West Exit of Shinjuku Station (JR, Odakyu and Keio lines). H¹T is a shared office for companies with no initial or base fees. This site stands out for its many seat types — open space, boxes, single-person rooms and seven meeting rooms — and is open 7:00–22:00 every day. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Open space 17 / boxes (4 × 1 person, 1 × 4 people) / 18 rooms (1) / 7 meeting rooms (3 × 2, 1 × 4, 3 × 6)
2 min from the West Exit of Shinjuku Sta. (exit 8) / 3 min from Shinjuku Sta. on the Toei Shinjuku and Oedo lines (exit 7)
concept: A Shinjuku base where you choose your seat
H¹T Shinjuku West Exit has 17 open-space seats, boxes for one and for four, 18 single rooms and seven meeting rooms for 2–6 people. Within one site, you choose the seat type to suit the work.

The website presents it as a satellite shared office suited to people doing sales rounds mainly in Tokyo's 23 wards. Two minutes from the West Exit of Shinjuku Station, it is open every day from 7:00 to 22:00.
steps: Use it to check email or prepare documents in short gaps.
There are four single boxes and one box for four.
The 18 single rooms have doors and suit online meetings.
There are seven meeting rooms: three for 2, one for 4 and three for 6.
Even when interviews and small meetings overlap, it is easy to get a room.

word.title: What is an H¹T box?
body: One of H¹T's seat types, between the open space and a private room. H¹T Shinjuku West Exit has boxes for one and for four.
Use them when you want to focus alone, or for a short talk with a few people.

credits: H¹T (Nomura Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.)

H¹T is a shared office for companies with no initial or base fees. Built around 15 single-person rooms, this site also has an open space, boxes and meeting rooms for 2–10, and is open 8:30–21:00 on weekends and holidays too. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Open space 7 / 2 boxes (1) / 15 rooms (1) / meeting rooms for 2, 3 and 10
2 min from exit A2 of Omotesando Sta. (Ginza, Hanzomon lines)
concept: An Omotesando base built around private rooms
H¹T Omotesando centres on 15 single rooms, plus 7 open-space seats, 2 single boxes and 3 meeting rooms — sized for 2, 3 and 10.

Use them in short gaps before your next appointment to check email.
The 15 single rooms are the heart of this site.
With doors, they suit online meetings and focused work.

word.title: What does “no initial or base fees” mean?
body: H¹T's pricing approach as a corporate shared office: no up-front cost when signing up and no base charge when you don't use it.
For companies using several sites, the advantage is paying only for what is used.

credits: H¹T (Nomura Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.)

name: fabbit Shibuya Ekimae

title: fabbit Shibuya Ekimae — a rental office with TKP meeting rooms on the same floor, on the 5th floor of the Shibuya Higashiguchi Building

It is listed on the official website of the rental-office brand CROSSCOOP as one of its sites. It has fully private rooms for 6 to about 18 people, a coworking space and TKP meeting rooms on the same floor. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Private rooms (6 to about 18 people) / coworking space / TKP meeting rooms (same floor)
concept: Close to the station, with meetings handled in one place
The website presents it as a property close to the station, two minutes from Shibuya Station, suited to opening a branch or setting up a project base.
Its feature is TKP meeting rooms on the same floor — large meetings, seminars and client meetings can all be handled in one facility.
steps: The entrance is on the 5th floor of the Shibuya Higashiguchi Building.
The coworking space is a shared area where private-room tenants can work outside their rooms.
Rooms for 6 to about 18 people are all fully private, and company registration is possible.

03 · TKP meeting rooms and the building
Meeting rooms on the same floor
TKP meeting rooms on the same floor handle large meetings and seminars.

name: CROSSCOOP Shibuya Nextsite
card: A lounge with indoor plants, themed + PERFORMANCE
title: CROSSCOOP Shibuya Nextsite — a planted lounge and 19 phone booths, on the 5th and 6th floors of the Nextsite Shibuya Building
lead: CROSSCOOP Shibuya Nextsite is on the 5th and 6th floors of the Nextsite Shibuya Building, seven minutes' walk from Shibuya Station and nine from Omotesando Station. Its motto is “+ PERFORMANCE”. It has a lounge with plants brought indoors, 7 meeting rooms, 19 phone booths and private rooms for 2 to 34 people. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Coworking lounge / refresh lounge / 7 meeting rooms / 19 phone booths / private rooms (2–34 people)
hero_cap: The corridor outside the meeting rooms
concept: + PERFORMANCE
CROSSCOOP Shibuya Nextsite's motto is “+ PERFORMANCE” — the idea that making people comfortable adds to the results of their work.
The website says it “creates a comfortable lounge space by placing plants inside the building”. It also has high security with face recognition.
steps: There are seven meeting rooms for 4 to 12 people and 19 phone booths.
The large number of booths suits a way of working with many online meetings.
The corridor outside the meeting rooms
Private rooms hold 2 to 34 people; the room for 22 is 54.85 m².
Desks and chairs in the offices are provided free, and company registration is possible.

word.title: What is a phone booth?
body: A small private booth you enter alone for calls and online meetings. CROSSCOOP Shibuya Nextsite has 19 of them.
Even when the lounge is full of conversation, you can step into a booth and talk quietly.
